options.name: prebuilt
options.description: Deploy existing Build Output Specification files without building

options.name: force
options.description: Allow upload in CI despite conflicting remote Worker changes

options.name: tag
options.description: A tag to associate with this Worker Version

options.name: message
options.description: A message to associate with this Worker Version

options.name: secrets-file
options.description: Path to a file containing secrets to upload with the version (JSON or .env format)

options.name: dry-run
options.description: Build a project and run checks without actually uploading the Worker

options.name: worker
options.description: Name of the Worker in the Build Output to use (defaults to the default Worker)

options.name: dispatch-namespace
options.description: Name of a dispatch namespace to deploy the Worker to (Workers for Platforms)

options.name: containers-rollout
options.description: Rollout strategy for Container changes. Immediate rolls out to all instances in one step; none leaves deployed Containers unchanged.
